text:
Olivia - GreenWave: Hi team — our payment for invoice INV-2026-014 ($72,540) was returned by our bank. They marked it as 'Invalid routing number' (ACH return R04). Vendor is asking for proof of payment, can we escalate? Trace: 20260317-8421

Samir Khan: Sorry to hear that, Olivia. Quick Qs: did you send this as a domestic ACH or a wire? Can you paste the ACH return record (R-code) or screenshot?

Olivia - GreenWave: Domestic ACH. Bank returned code R04 and the note says 'RETURN - INVALID ROUTING NUMBER'. We entered routing 021000002 on the billing form (we pulled SWIFT/BIC CHASUS33 from our bank portal and mistakenly used a different number). Account ends with 6789.

Samir Khan: Thanks — that points to a typo. Can you confirm the exact routing you typed in the Redwood billing page? Also please only share last 4 of the account (you already did, good). We'll loop in payments.

Anya Petrov: FYI R04 = invalid routing number. Looks like you used ABA 021000002 instead of 021000021. SWIFT/BIC (CHASUS33) is not interchangeable with ABA for domestic ACH — that mismatch can cause returns. Two immediate options: re-initiate ACH with the correct ABA, or send a same-day domestic wire. Which do you prefer?

Olivia - GreenWave: We prefer to re-initiate ACH. Can you confirm the correct ABA to use and any special reference fields we need to include so the vendor attribute credit to the invoice?

Maria Lopez: Looping Kevin from Billing to confirm hold/late-fee policy. Olivia — we can put the invoice into a temporary hold while we remediate, no late fees during this incident.

BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-014 status changed to 'payment_pending - returned'.

Kevin O'Neill: Confirmed — we'll waive the $15 returned-item fee for this case. Once the funds clear we need either the ACH trace number or bank confirmation (ACH return + new settlement) to mark paid.

Anya Petrov: Olivia, please use ABA 021000021 and account ending 6789 for the re-submission. If you want to send a wire instead, here are our wire details (copy paste into your bank's wire form):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: JPMorgan Chase
ABA (for domestic wire): 021000021
Account number: 1122334455
Beneficiary reference: INV-2026-014 / GreenWave
```

Note: For international SWIFT wires you'd include BIC CHASUS33, but for a US domestic ACH that SWIFT/BIC is not used. After you submit, send us the new ACH trace ID so we can watch settlement.

Samir Khan: Finance needs the bank return file or a screenshot of the return record for audit. Once you re-submit, please share the new trace. We'll open an internal billing ticket to track.

Olivia - GreenWave: Uploading screenshot now. Re-issuing ACH with corrected ABA in ~25 minutes.

Olivia - GreenWave: Update — bank accepted the re-initiation. New trace ID pending: 20260317-8422 (pending). Will follow up once it posts.

BillingBot: Noted new trace 20260317-8422 and resumed monitoring.

Kevin O'Neill: Thanks, team. Once 8422 settles and funds clear we'll reconcile and close INV-2026-014. No penalties.

Anya Petrov: I'll watch the settlement feed for the new trace and set an alert to ping this thread if it doesn't land within 2 business days. :eyes:

Samir Khan: Closing the loop for now — Olivia, DM me if the bank shows any further returns or if you need us to accept a wire instead. We'll keep the invoice on hold until confirmed. :white_check_mark:
